_doc: Kethrys Spire, the mage city (the user's list of 2026-11-08b, docs/improvements9.txt: 'a mage-city clustered around a black tower that hasn't opened its gates in a century. there are magical effects, laboratories, libraries, stone houses. this city is not poor'). Its people and quests, read by 906 (the townsfolk and quests of the town 'Kethrys Spire'; the bodies are the NPC packs' as the other cities'). Roles the town uses its own for: the archmage (Elder: talk, quests), the archivist (Scholar), the warden-captain (Captain), the scribes in the libraries (Monk), the alchemists in the laboratories (Worker), the apprentices about the square (Pilgrim), the Spire's wardens at the tower (Soldier).

townsfolk.name: KS_Archmage
townsfolk.title: Archmage Velis Kethran
lines: A hundred years the Black Tower has kept its gate shut. Something inside is still awake.
The Spire Key was taken down into the dark under Graymourne. If you have it, the tower will open for you.
Mind the wards. They do not know friend from thief.
topics: What is the Black Tower?|The first archmage built it to hold what she could not destroy. When she died the gate sealed itself. We have studied its wards ever since.
Why do you need me?|Because the wards answer only to the key, and the key answers only to whoever carries it. None of us has dared.

townsfolk.name: KS_Archivist
townsfolk.title: Archivist Mirel Ondra
townsfolk.calling: the keeper of the Spire's libraries
lines: Every book in the three libraries, and not one says what is at the top of the tower.
Quiet, please. The scribes are copying the warding texts.
topics: What is happening?|The tower's light has changed colour twice this year. The archmage says it is waking. I say it was never asleep.
The libraries?|Three of them, and the laboratories between. Ask the scribes; they know the shelves better than I do.

townsfolk.name: KS_Captain
townsfolk.title: Warden-Captain Iska Thorne
townsfolk.calling: the captain of the Spire's wardens
lines: My wardens stand at the tower's gate day and night. Nothing has come out. Yet.
If you go in, go armed for magic. Steel alone won't do it.

townsfolk.name: KS_Priest
townsfolk.title: Mother Selwyn
lines: Even mages pray. Mostly before experiments.

townsfolk.name: KS_Smith
townsfolk.title: Hollen the Runesmith
lines: I etch runes into steel. Bring me something worth etching.

townsfolk.name: KS_Trader
townsfolk.title: Quillon Vey
lines: Reagents, inks, the odd sword. Prices fair, questions fewer.

townsfolk.name: KS_Healer
townsfolk.title: Sister Amarah
lines: Arcane burns heal slower than fire. Sit, let me look.

townsfolk.name: KS_Keeper
townsfolk.title: Oswin the Ledger
lines: Your things are safe here. The vault is warded twice.

townsfolk.name: KS_Innkeeper
townsfolk.title: Bess Lanterne
lines: The ale's honest. The mages drink tea, mostly. Strange folk.

townsfolk.name: KS_Preacher
townsfolk.title: Brother Aethel
lines: Pride built that tower. Pride will open it. Mark me.

townsfolk.name: KS_Scribe1
townsfolk.title: a scribe of the Spire
lines: Shh. One wrong stroke and the ward has to be copied again from the start.
The oldest book here is older than the tower. Nobody can read it.

townsfolk.name: KS_Scribe2
townsfolk.title: a scribe of the Spire
lines: The libraries never close. Neither do the scribes' eyes, it feels like.

townsfolk.name: KS_Alchemist1
townsfolk.title: an alchemist
lines: Stand back from the cauldron. It doesn't like strangers.
Moonleaf, ash and a drop of quicksilver. Don't drink it.

townsfolk.name: KS_Alchemist2
townsfolk.title: an alchemist
lines: The green ones heal. The blue ones... we're still finding out.

townsfolk.name: KS_Apprentice1
townsfolk.title: an apprentice mage
lines: I lit my sleeve on fire again today. Progress!
The rune circle hums if you stand in it. Try it.

townsfolk.name: KS_Apprentice2
townsfolk.title: an apprentice mage
lines: The archmage looked at me today. I think. Maybe past me.

townsfolk.name: KS_Warden1
townsfolk.title: a warden of the Spire
lines: No one passes the gate. Not that anyone has wanted to.

townsfolk.name: KS_Warden2
townsfolk.title: a warden of the Spire
lines: Sometimes you can hear it breathing. The tower, I mean.

townsfolk.name: KS_Guard1
townsfolk.title: a guard of the Spire
lines: Welcome to Kethrys Spire. Keep your spells in your pockets.

townsfolk.name: KS_Guard2
townsfolk.title: a guard of the Spire
lines: The road from Graymourne is worse every month. Things come down from the hills.

townsfolk.name: KS_Militia1
townsfolk.title: a watchman on the walls
lines: From up here you can see the tower's light all the way to the coast.

townsfolk.name: KS_Militia2
townsfolk.title: a watchman on the walls
lines: Quiet night. They're all quiet nights here. That's what worries me.

townsfolk.name: KS_Child1
townsfolk.title: Elia Brightwick
lines: I can make sparks! Watch! ...they were there a moment ago.

townsfolk.name: KS_Child2
townsfolk.title: Tobyn
lines: My mum says the tower eats people who knock. I knocked. Nothing happened.

townsfolk.name: KS_Mourner
townsfolk.title: Widow Carrow
lines: He went to study the wards, and the wards studied him.

townsfolk.name: KS_Idiot
townsfolk.title: Fizzwick the Unbound
lines: I am the greatest mage in Kethrys! I can make a coin vanish! ...can I borrow a coin?

townsfolk.name: KS_Citizen1
townsfolk.title: a citizen
lines: Good stone, good streets, good wages. Just don't look at the tower too long.

townsfolk.name: KS_Citizen2
townsfolk.title: a citizen
lines: My neighbour's a mage. He waters his roses by thinking at them.

townsfolk.name: KS_Citizen3
townsfolk.title: a citizen
lines: We are not poor here. We are careful.

quests.title: The Gate of a Hundred Years
quests.offer: Take the Spire Key and open the Black Tower's gate. Go in, and come back to tell me what you saw.
quests.done: So it opened. And you came back. That is more than any of us could say.
quests.hint: The gate is at the far wall of the tower's hall.

quests.title: Halls of the Tower
quests.offer: The tower has many halls. Reach the second, and learn what guards it.
quests.done: Deeper than our oldest maps. Keep going.

quests.title: The Heart of the Spire
quests.offer: Reach the tower's fourth hall. Whatever woke, it lives there.
quests.done: The wards are calmer already. The Spire owes you.

quests.title: Thin the Wards
quests.offer: Things walk the tower's halls. Put down twenty-five of them so my wardens can sleep.
quests.done: Twenty-five. My wardens will drink to you tonight.

quests.title: The Tower's Master
quests.offer: Something rules the tower's halls. Find it and end it.
quests.done: Its master is dead? Then the tower is ours again, at last.

quests.title: The Scribes' Account
quests.offer: Speak with one of the scribes in the libraries. They have been copying something they will not show me.
quests.done: Warding texts... for a door that opens outward. Interesting.

quests.title: Notice: Wardbreakers Wanted
quests.offer: Wanted: wardbreakers for the tower's lower halls. Ten kills, paid in full.
